subject: Re: Encord <> Boston Dynamics | Delivery, Support & Renewal
text:
Hi Shivant,

Thank you for providing the detailed project updates and the renewal
options.

A few questions on the offerings:

   - Curate - It is my understanding that most teams are currently using
   this as it was offered as a free trial to us this past year, correct?
   - Index - Only a couple of teams have tested with index, while other
   teams are doing their own indexing and SAM3 routing, correct?
   - FDE - We have very much appreciated the FDE support thus far! I know
   that the signed URL architecture has been bumpy, and now there are new
   custom asks to be able to support Atlas.
      - As one of your "smaller" humanoid customers, I'm surprised there is
      still so much custom work required to support these types of datasets and
      annotation types.
      - Is this something truly unique to our requests for Encord?
      - If there are recommended ways to approach our data ingestion and
      technical pipeline that require less technical support, have we explored
      those options?
         - This may just be the "dumb PM" in me, but I would expect more
         out of the box solutions that work at scale with some of your other
         customers, considering we are approaching a year in the engagement and
         still have fundamental ingestion and pipeline support work to
complete.
      - If we *do not *decide to pay for FDE services, what type of access
      to filing bugs, and other issues we may have that are not "net new
      features" will we receive?
         - Will we begin to be charged on a rolling monthly basis for FDE
         services of projects not completed by 7/27/26?

Best,

Ben Gowaski
Product Manager
*Boston**Dynamics*

subject: Re: Follow Up to our Discussion- Encord
text:
Hi Zachary,

 I gave Claude Code Label Studio's React plugin documentation page and then
told it to create the UI there.
Then it coded out and pushed the changes there. I tested the UI and then
told Claude some bugs and then it fixed directly.
I never looked into the source code directly as the UI will be only facing
annotators and annotators will also report issue to me so all these changes
are very low risk.

It supported drawing table boundary lines pretty easily and I can multi
select the grids to create merge cells easily. I then created Excel like
interaction page pretty easily too where I can copy paste and modify bulk
number of table cells.
Maintenance is pretty easy since I just rely on vibe code and the risk of
breaking is very low.

Beyond parsing UI, we care about for managing different roles for
annotators and controlling their access on data.

Given Label Studio gives full flexibility on code, what matters the most is
if Encord can match this feature.
I can build any UI without needing any front end engineer or ask infra
engineer on deployment which is super handy for MLE to iterate fast and
experiment on different ways of annotating
I can instantly apply changes that annotators flagged.

But something I think Encord could be better is the support and
responsivensss. Given it was really difficult to get Label Studio's
attention, we find that part a risk.

Best,
Joon
